notes:
No more hearing the same line twice.

Long pages are read in overlapping slices so a speech balloon sitting on a join survives whole. When the same balloon turned up in two slices the app was meant to notice and read it once — but it compared the two copies letter for letter, and the text reader makes slightly different mistakes on each slice ("don't" in one, "dont" in the other). Neither copy matched, so both were read aloud.

They are now compared by their words rather than their spelling, and a balloon cut across a join is recognised as one balloon instead of two neighbours.
